_comment: ERC violations reviewed and accepted for the SunSprout Satellite board. tools/check_erc_baseline.py fails CI only on violations absent from this list. Matched on (type, symbol reference).

accepted.description: Symbol U1 Pin 1 [VDD(A), Power input, Line]
accepted.reason: SAT_3V3 is an externally supplied rail arriving via the RJ45 cable (VCC_1/VCC_2 through jumper JP14) rather than generated by an on-board voltage regulator power output pin.
